source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of data buffering (PDF 105).

blocks.text: Data streams (lagataar aane wala data) ko buffer karne mein queues ka bara role (kaam) hai; buffering ka matlab hai data ko thori der ke liye aage se jama kar ke rakhna. Is se data achhi tarah sambhala aur process hota hai. Do misalein dekhein:

items: Online video streaming: online video ek dam poori nahi chalti, balke chhote chhote tukron (chunks) mein buffer hoti hai. Video chalte waqt ek queue aap ke dekhe ja rahe hisse se aage ke hisse jama aur load karti rehti hai. Is buffering queue ki wajah se internet se data aane mein der ho tab bhi video bina ruke chalti hai.

Printer queue: sochiye aap ke paas chhapne ke liye kai documents hain magar printer ek waqt mein ek hi document chhap sakta hai. Kai print jobs bhejne par woh queue mein lag jate hain, aur printer unhein aane ke order (tarteeb) se chhapta hai. Is tarah har document ek ke baad ek, bina gar-bar ke chhapta hai.

blocks.prompt: Agar buffer queue khali ho jaye to streaming video ka kya hota hai?
blocks.explanation: Video ruk jati hai ('buffering' dikhata hai) jab tak naye tukre aa kar queue mein na jur jayen.

items: Buffering: queue data ke tukre pehle se jama rakhti hai taake streaming aur printing bina ruke chalein.
